title: Dominate
summary: DOMINATE, verb transitive [Latin See Dominant.] To rule; to govern; to prevail; to predominate over. We every where meet the Slavonian nations either dominant or dominated. DOMINATE, verb intransitive

inlines.v: DOMINATE, verb transitive [Latin See Dominant.] To rule; to govern; to prevail; to predominate over. We every where meet the Slavonian nations either dominant or dominated. DOMINATE, verb intransitive To predominate. [Little used.]
